name: Nemuro Peninsula Chashi Sites
description: The Nemuro Peninsula Chashi Sites are a group of Ainu fortress ruins (chashi) along the peninsula's cliffed coast, selected as No. 1 of the Japan 100 Castles for their testimony to the fortified settlements of the Ainu people.
notes: The chashi are open-air earthwork sites; visit the Nemuro City History and Folklore Museum for interpretation. Access is by car from Nemuro city center; the peninsula road is best in summer.
businessHours: Open access (castle ruins; see official site for seasonal hours)
openingHoursJa: 城跡は自由に見学可（季節により開館時間が変わる施設あり）

ja.name: 根室半島チャシ跡群
ja.description: 根室半島の断崖に築かれたアイヌのチャシ（砦）跡群。北海道東端の根室に残るアイヌの防御遺構として、日本100名城第1号に選ばれています。
ja.notes: チャシは野外の土塁遺構です。根室市歴史と自然の資料館で解説をどうぞ。車での周遊が便利です。
ja.parking: 周辺の無料・有料駐車場あり（施設により異なる）
